description: How crime varies across a city, by census block group, for one measure (default total_major): a summary of every block group in the place (index quartiles, and the block groups and residents in each index band, with their shares of the block groups that have an index and of those block groups' residents), plus one page of block groups (default 25, highest index first) with each one's index, 80% interval, percentile and confidence. offset pages through the rest; order=asc lists the lowest first. Each call counts as one lookup.

crime.description: A summary (total_major, persons, property, disorder) or one of the 16 crimes

limit.description: Block groups in this page (default 25, max 100)

offset.description: Rows to skip, from the previous page's paging.next_offset

order.description: Default desc for index (highest first), asc for bg_geoid

place_id.description: A place_id such as 'tx/houston', or a 7-digit place GEOID

name: place_block_groups
title: Block groups in a place
